description: This file defines classes and interfaces related to network routing and adapter management within the WPEFramework Core namespace. It includes classes for routing table entries, network adapters, and iterators for network addresses, as well as observer interfaces for network events.

classes.name: RoutingTable
classes.description: Represents a routing table, containing multiple Route entries, with methods to manage and access routing information.

classes.name: RoutingTable::Route
classes.description: Represents a single route entry in the routing table, including source, destination, gateway, and other routing parameters.

classes.name: AdapterObserver
classes.description: Provides an interface to observe network adapter events, with callback mechanisms for event notifications.

classes.name: AdapterObserver::INotification
classes.description: Interface for receiving notifications about network adapter events such as Event, Added, and Removed.

classes.name: IPV4AddressIterator
classes.description: Iterator class for traversing IPv4 addresses associated with a network adapter or list.

classes.name: IPV6AddressIterator
classes.description: Iterator class for traversing IPv6 addresses associated with a network adapter or list.

classes.name: AdapterIterator
classes.description: Iterator class for enumerating network adapters, providing access to properties like name, MAC address, and address lists.

classes.name: Network
classes.description: Represents a network interface, managing IP addresses, MAC address, and network state.

methods.name: RoutingTable::Route::Interface
methods.description: Returns the interface name associated with the route.

methods.name: AdapterObserver::Open
methods.description: Opens the adapter observer to start receiving notifications.

methods.name: AdapterObserver::Close
methods.description: Closes the adapter observer, stopping notifications.

methods.name: IPV4AddressIterator::Address
methods.description: Returns the current IPNode address in the IPv4 address iteration.

methods.name: IPV6AddressIterator::Address
methods.description: Returns the current IPNode address in the IPv6 address iteration.

methods.name: AdapterIterator::Name
methods.description: Returns the name of the current network adapter.

methods.name: AdapterIterator::MACAddress
methods.description: Returns the MAC address of the current network adapter as a string with delimiters.

methods.name: AdapterIterator::IsUp
methods.description: Checks if the current network adapter is up.

methods.name: AdapterIterator::Up
methods.description: Enables or disables the network adapter.
